description: This file defines SQL functions related to OpenID Connect (OIDC) user information and logout procedures for SQLPage, including functions to access user claims, ID tokens, and generate secure logout URLs.

methods.name: user_info_token
methods.description: Accesses the entire ID token as a JSON object for the current user, available only when logged in with SSO.

methods.name: user_info
methods.description: Retrieves specific user claim information (e.g., name, email, sub) for the current logged-in user.

methods.name: oidc_logout_url
methods.description: Generates a secure URL to log out the user from SQLPage and the OIDC provider, with CSRF protection and redirect options.
